659:t_005:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「If all you can think about is wiping us out, we're not about to back down either!」

659:t_005:9.en:
$n
「We're not going to let you kill us without a fight!」

659:t_005:10.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If it's kill or be killed, I won't hold back! I'll settle things with you right here, $$インベーダー#pilot$$!」

659:t_005:11.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「Just you wait, Earthlings! Until we are filled with the Great Void's essence!」

659:t_005:12.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「That will be your end! And we shall obtain the power of $$シンカ$$!」

659:t_006:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「After all that showing off, you're running away after all?!」

659:t_006:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「It seems they intend to buy time using their $$インベーダー#pilot$$ minions.」

659:t_006:2.en:
$$葵$$
「Bring it on! Ravenous destroyers or incarnations of endless destruction, I'll defeat anyone blocking our way!」

659:t_006:3.en:
$$凱$$
「This is the moment of truth! Let's do it, everyone!」

659:t_006:4.en:
$$渓$$
「Just you wait, $$コーウェン$$, $$スティンガー$$! We'll never lose!」

659:t_006:5.en:
$$號$$
「We will live! That is the power that will defeat the Great Void!!」

659:t_007:1.en:
$$渓$$
「You mean... $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$!」

659:t_008:0.en:
$$凱$$
「After all that buildup, you don't look much different from during the $$再世戦争$$!」

659:t_008:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Do not underestimate our power, Earthlings.」

659:t_008:2.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「This is the space of the Great Void! You, who live under the natural order of the force that seeks to exist, cannot win!」

659:t_009:1.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Four more of those things appeared!」

659:t_009:2.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Duplicates?! Or others of the same type?!」

659:t_009:4.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We are all ourselves.」

659:t_009:5.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「This is the space of the Great Void... All its laws differ from those of the world outside.」

659:t_009:6.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Bearing its essence, we are one and all, all and one.」

659:t_009:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「A world with a different natural order... So they too wield $$次元力$$.」

659:t_009:9.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Though you stand at the threshold of $$シンカ$$, it seems you have yet to realize the essence of $$オリジン・ロー$$.」

659:t_009:10.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「So $$ゲッター線$$ will choose us after all.」

659:t_009:13.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「We cannot tell you.」

659:t_009:14.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「But rest assured. You shall gain eternity within us.」

659:t_009:16.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「You, who are coming to grasp the truth, and we, who have grasped the essence of $$オリジン・ロー$$...」

659:t_009:17.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「If the two are combined, the strongest species in the universe should be born!」

659:t_009:18.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Yes! It is the fusion of the force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist!」

659:t_009:19.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Come, Earthlings! Offer your souls and your bodies of steel to us!」

659:t_010:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Like hell we'd hand our lives over to the $$バアル$$!」

659:t_010:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Do not call us $$バアル$$!」

659:t_010:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
「No! You really are $$バアル$$ after all!」

659:t_010:3.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「No! You really are $$バアル$$ after all!」

659:t_010:4.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「No! You really are $$バアル$$ after all!」

659:t_010:5.en:
$$桂$$
「I thought there might be a chance we'd understand each other if we talked, but it looks like there's just no way we'll get along.」

659:t_010:6.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You do nothing but take other lives for your own desires. You have no right to live in this universe.」

659:t_010:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「And you're drowning in the Great Void... in the force that seeks to vanish!」

659:t_010:8.en:
$$タケル$$
「If you use that power to destroy the universe, you're humanity's natural enemy... $$バアル$$!」

659:t_010:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「At this point, it doesn't matter whether the $$御使い$$s knew that, or whether you became that way because they branded you $$バアル$$.」

659:t_010:10.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If you intend to take our lives for your own evolution, we'll resist with everything we've got!」

659:t_010:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I don't give a damn about gods or demons, vanishing or existing!」

659:t_010:12.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I'll just fight to the death against anyone who won't let me live!」

659:t_010:13.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Do not think you can win, Earthlings!」

659:t_010:14.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「This is the space of the Great Void...! Now that we have its power, we are invincible!」

659:t_010:15.en:
$$弁慶$$
「We've come this far. Enough of your prattle!」

659:t_010:16.en:
$$隼人$$
「Us or you...! This fight decides who survives!」

659:t_010:17.en:
$$凱$$
「But we won't lose! We can't afford to!」

659:t_010:18.en:
$$渓$$
「We're different from you! You spread destruction everywhere! We have things we're fighting for!」

659:t_010:19.en:
$$號$$
「That is what you can never reach! The truth of those who live in this universe!」

659:t_010:20.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's settle this, $$インベーダー#pilot$$! Even if this is the Great Void's world, I'm here... we're here!」

659:t_010:21.en:
$$竜馬$$
「As long as we're alive, like hell we'll hand this world over to the Great Void!!」

659:t_011:0.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Impossible! Why can we not win?!」

659:t_011:1.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Do we not bear the Great Void's essence? Are we not the chosen species blessed by $$ゲッター線$$?!」

659:t_011:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「There aren't chosen and unchosen lives! You tried to wipe out other living things on your own say-so, and they just fought back!」

659:t_011:3.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Silence, silence! Either way, you are finished too!」

659:t_011:4.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「The Great Void will fill this universe! Then the universe itself will perish!」

659:t_012:5.en:
$$早乙女$$
(Remember. The days when we researched $$ゲッター線$$ together.)

659:t_012:7.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「That form! Have you been absorbed into $$ゲッター線$$?!」

659:t_012:8.en:
$$早乙女$$
(I was not absorbed. I became one with them.)

659:t_012:9.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Have you come to laugh at us because we cannot attain $$シンカ$$?!」

659:t_012:10.en:
$$インベーダー#pilot$$
「Why?! Why can we not grasp the truth?!」

659:t_012:11.en:
$$早乙女$$
(If you remember what you have forgotten, you too can reach it.)
